in_sanskrit.name: Bidisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bidisha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bidisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vidisha’, which means ‘abode of knowledge’. In Hindu mythology, Bidisha is the goddess who is believed to be the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. She is revered by scholars and students alike for her ability to bestow knowledge and understanding.

She is revered by scholars and students alike for her ability to bestow knowledge and understanding.
